name: @isocan/voice-agent
//: The voice agent is a page and a harness that run themselves: `npm start` here (or `npx voice-agent`) starts the harness a person talks to, and `npx isocan rc` starts the SAME entry as a supervisor — see bin/voice-agent.js. No runtime dependencies beyond the isocan packages it speaks to: the page is markup, a controller and two modules that import nothing but browser globals, and that is the point of the package.
